instruction.german: Write an article to advertise a sports event at your school. Answer these questions:

parts:
What’s the name of the event?

When does the event take place?

What are the games or sports that students play?

Are there any competitions? What do students do in each one?

Where can students find more information about the event?

 

You can start sentences in your article with:

In this game/competition/race, you/players (can) ...

There are (four players) in this game.

Are you good at ...? Then this is the ... for you!

Check ... for more information.
